app.title: Nuudelchin — Zuslan (summer camp)
hud.away: Herder is busy (moving / at sum center)
help.title: Controls
help.body:
WASD / arrows — walk (Shift — run) · click ground — go there
Drag mouse — rotate camera · wheel — zoom
Space — "Khööe!": nearby animals bunch and move away from you
U — hold/put away the herding stick. With it animals shy away from you
F — mount / dismount · H — call horse
Q — scare wolves (45 m, 60 m mounted). Wolves attack unprotected animals inside their territory (red ring)
Z — protection zones: pen, tent, herder (15 m, 20 m mounted), dog (10 m), stallion (15 m)
K — dog orders (follow me, stay here, patrol here, patrol camp, guard herd) · N — all dogs follow me
M — move camp: staying long degrades pasture and grass regrows slower
Herds go to water and new pasture on their own: together when far from water, one by one when near
Walk over milk/wool to collect (10 units), store it near the tent · E — pick up / store
B — storage & processing · T — trip to the sum center (sell, buy animals/dogs)
1 / 2 / 3 — speed 1× 2× 4× · G — pasture heatmap · F1 — help · ` — cheat menu
Night: in the evening animals walk home by themselves (sheep into the pen, cows beside it) and sleep. Animals too far away sleep where they are. In the morning they leave milk and wool where they slept — the amount depends on how well they grazed the day before. At night a wolf may come to the camp and attack animals sleeping outside it. Cart and trucks drive to the sum center along the road.
